visualChecks.front: Silhouette and waist/hip ratio improved; limb control curves are smoother, but the torso remains mannequin-like and the reference match is not yet close.
visualChecks.side: Breast root is integrated into the torso and foot length/instep improved; head, thorax, glute, knee and foot anatomy remain below character-quality.
visualChecks.back: Waist and hip flow are clearer, but scapular, gluteal fold, hamstring and calf planes remain insufficient.
visualChecks.threeQuarter: The continuous body is cleaner, but shoulder seams, pelvis/perineum, hand and foot forms still read procedurally.
visualChecks.shoulderFlow: Arm spline and width improved; a deltoid cap seam and weak clavicle/axilla definition remain.
visualChecks.torsoPelvisFlow: Chest is no longer made from detached button masses and the central pelvis no longer self-intersects, but inguinal/perineal anatomy still fails close visual inspection.
visualChecks.handsAndFingers: All five digits are present and separated, but palm, thumb web, knuckles and digit thickness still require a dedicated anatomical pass.
visualChecks.feet: Foot now has a longer toe box and a defined instep/heel profile; arch, ball and ankle transition still look soft and blob-like.
visualChecks.face: The dedicated close-up confirms the face is not close to the anime reference: head is broad/boxy, eyes are small and protruding, lids/brows are rigid strips, nose has an open triangular underside, lips float as a separate oval, and jaw/chin/cheek planes are not sculpted.
visualChecks.overall: Technical build passes and several silhouette regressions were fixed. Visual QA remains rejected; do not proceed to release/commit.

blockingIssues: Face/head is not close to the authoritative anime reference: rebuild eye sockets and embedding, expressive eye proportions, cheek planes, jaw/chin, nose, lips and side profile.
Shoulder/clavicle/axilla flow remains cap-like and too broad, with a visible arm attachment seam.
Hip-to-thigh, glute and crotch transitions remain procedural; the perineal/inguinal arch needs continuous anatomy rather than a shelf.
Hands have separated digits but still lack natural palm, knuckle and thumb-web anatomy.
Feet remain blob-like; heel, arch, ball and toe-box landmarks need a dedicated rebuild.
Do not proceed to hair, bodysuit, armor, rig or animation release work until the HUMAN_BASE visual gate is independently approved.
releaseGate: Do not start armor/hair/rig release work and do not commit or push the final asset.
